title: Generate-then-Rank: Learning Symbolic Goal Interpretation for Embodied Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07825v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Goal interpretation is to translate a natural language instruction into a formal symbolic goal that a planner can execute. It is critical for embodied agents because any error here propagates to every downstream planning and action step. Doing it well requires both generating suitable candidates and reliably selecting among them. We present a two-stage generate-then-rank approach to Goal Interpretation in the Embodied Agent Interface (EAI). First, supervised fine-tuning adapts a Large Language Model (LLM) to EAI's output convention. Second, Candidate-Output Ranking from Errors (CORE) learns preferences over complete outputs from the model's own generated alternatives. We conducted experiments on the household scenes of the Embodied Agent Interface Benchmark. translated_title: 生成后排序：学习具身智能体的符号目标解释
translated_abstract: 目标解释是将自然语言指令翻译成规划器可执行的正式符号目标。这对具身智能体至关重要，因为该环节的任何错误都会传播到下游的所有规划与行动步骤。要做好这一任务，既需要生成合适的候选结果，也需要在其中进行可靠的选择。我们提出了一种面向具身智能体接口（EAI）中目标解释的两阶段“生成后排序”方法。首先，通过监督微调使大语言模型（LLM）适应EAI的输出规范；其次，基于错误的候选输出排序方法（CORE）从模型自身生成的备选输出中学习对完整输出的偏好。我们在具身智能体接口基准的家庭场景上进行了实验，评估了多个开源大语言模型，包括DeepSeek-V3 chat、DeepSeek-Reasoner以及Qwen2.5-7B和Qwen2.5-72B。所提出的方法超越了包括……在内的基线模型。
tldr: 该论文提出两阶段“生成后排序”方法用于具身智能体的符号目标解释，通过监督微调适配输出规范并结合基于错误的候选输出排序（CORE）学习输出偏好，在EAI基准上超越了现有基线模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a two-stage generate-then-rank approach for symbolic goal interpretation in embodied agents, combining supervised fine-tuning with error-based Candidate-Output Ranking (CORE), which outperforms baseline models on the EAI benchmark.
